title: Robotic Liberation by PWP (VIC-20)
summary: Robotic Liberation by PWP is a music video demo performed entirely by an unexpanded Commodore VIC-20 and a 1541 disk drive, using only a few kilobytes of RAM and a 16 KB disk. It uses demoscene effects to tell a story.
why: HN recommends it as a showcase of what skilled demoscene programmers can squeeze out of extremely limited hardware.

quote.text: I like that the demo effects are used here to tell a story in addition to being a pure display of coding prowess.
